comments.body:
Agentic Code Reviewer cursor-sdk

⚠️ **WARNING:** The JSON follow-up reuses the same AbortController that was armed at the start of runOpencodeStream, so the recovery turn only gets whatever time remains after the first (often tool-heavy) prompt completes. When the first turn finishes near TIMEOUT_MS with no usable text — the exact scenario this PR targets — the follow-up is aborted almost immediately and the job surfaces a timeout instead of recovering or returning the empty-text diagnostics.

**Correção sugerida:**

```ts
if (isRetryableIncompleteAssistant(response.info, fullText)) {
  clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
  timeoutHandle = setTimeout(() => abortController.abort(), timeoutMs);
  // ... existing follow-up sendSessionPrompt ...
}
```
Alternatively arm a nested AbortController for the follow-up so the initial long turn cannot consume the recovery budget.

<details>
<summary>🔍 Detalhes da Análise IA</summary>

**Score:** 7/10 | **Ação dev:** fix-code

**Análise:**
1. Evidence: Read src/engine/opencode/stream.ts (lines 290–291 setTimeout on abortController; lines 333–355 retry via sendSessionPrompt with the same abortController.signal). docs/faq.md § OpenCode empty textPart documents one follow-up for reasoning-only / output-length failures after long runs. 2. Scenario: A review with many tool calls runs for ~TIMEOUT_MS−5s, returns reasoning-only parts (fullText empty, isRetryableIncompleteAssistant true). The follow-up starts with ~5s left on the shared timer and aborts before the model can emit JSON, producing the generic timeout error path (lines 393–407) instead of JSON recovery. 3. Protection: test/opencode-assistant-text.test.ts covers helper predicates only; no test exercises runOpencodeStream timeout budget across two prompts. 4. Discards: Considered event-stream inactivity as root cause — that aborts during the first prompt and never reaches the retry branch; considered unbounded retries — code intentionally allows only one follow-up, which is fine once the follow-up has its own time budget.

**Caminhos analisados:** src/engine/opencode/stream.ts, src/engine/opencode/assistant-text.ts, test/opencode-assistant-text.test.ts, docs/faq.md
</details>
